`grid-12mp-512px-tiles.heic` is the 4032x3024, 8x6 512px-tile grid sample from https://heic.fyi/heic-sample-files. The source page identifies all samples as CC0. SHA-256: ed14b6e639fc61ce19b933163579ea23f226aa2f0a78cb757753628bcee0e55e.

`input-24mp-single.heic` and `input-64mp-grid.heic` are synthetic test charts generated locally with libheif and x265; no third-party images are used.
